name: crystalaid
description: CrystalAid - Discord Bot + Activity + Backend + Realtime Gamification Ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/config && npm run build --workspace=packages/database
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=apps/activity && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/bot
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
